summary: i3 Verticals, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its board approved a new $100 million share repurchase program for its Class A common stock, replacing a prior program that was fully expended. Repurchases may be made in open market, privately negotiated transactions, or under Rule 10b5-1 plans through May 11, 2027, subject to market conditions, liquidity, contractual restrictions, and securities law compliance. The program is discretionary and may be suspended or terminated at any time. Watch for actual repurchase activity and impact on diluted share count; no premium or fixed price is specified.
